top_signals.title: Oil prices rise after Iran says it attacked two tankers transiting Strait of Hormuz
top_signals.summary: Commonwealth Bank of Australia said in a note on Friday that stronger oil flows through the Strait of Hormuz had eased market concerns after U.S.-Iran strikes earlier this week.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Chipmakers Rise at End of Dizzying July for Stocks: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Another wave of buying lifted beaten-down chipmakers in the final stretch of a month that saw an unwinding of strategies that have powered the stock rally from war-driven lows.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Reddit Shares Plunge by Record on Dearth of New AI Deals
top_signals.summary: Reddit Inc. shares suffered their worst intraday drop ever after the social media company failed to announce any new data licensing agreements in its latest earnings report, disappointing investors who are hoping to see a shift in revenue streams.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Ethereum’s 43-day staking queue isn’t a clean demand signal, Sygnum says
top_signals.summary: Sygnum's Thomas Brunner says Ethereum’s 43-day staking queue reflects mechanics, not just fresh demand from investors.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
